title: Man dies in RCMP custody in Cape Dorset
subtitle: 29-year-old found unresponsive early Friday morning
article: An independent investigation is underway after a 29-year-old man died while in police custody in Cape Dorset, Nunavut, early Friday.
RCMP say the man was found unresponsive in a holding cell in the early morning hours and was later pronounced dead.

He had been arrested by RCMP Thursday evening after police received a complaint of an intoxicated male and an assault. In a news release, RCMP say the man was co-operative when taken into custody and was lodged in the cell without incident.
The cause of death has not yet been determined. RCMP say the investigation is continuing with the assistance of the Ottawa Police Service and Nunavut's Office of the Chief Coroner.
The Ottawa Police Service will conduct an investigation of the circumstances related to the man's death.
